🚀 Welcome to VELUGU VYOM

We are a passionate team of innovators, developers and space enthusiasts ready to explore real-world challenges through technology. Our interests include AI/ML, programming, data analysis, web development, research and creative problem-solving. We believe in learning, collaborating and building impactful solutions.
We welcome enthusiastic coders, designers, researchers and problem-solvers who are curious, creative and ready to innovate. Let's explore and win together.
